stages.name: recv-registry-slot
stages.note: Channel 0x14 table B (recv) entry 513. Table B is proven recv from FUN_140fecd10 installing 32-byte MsgRegistryRecord slots with dispatchType=1 and handlerFn at +0x18 (see msg-dispatch-addenda Addendum 7). defArray at 1425cd320, handler FUN_141257a20 in ChCliMsg.cpp.

stages.name: defarray-chain
stages.note: Descriptor chain at 1425cd320: fieldType 1 (MP_MSGID, id 0x264) -> 4 -> 2 -> 2 -> 4 -> terminal. Read byte-for-byte from the image; matches msg-dispatch-addenda Addendum 8.

stages.name: decoded-record-shape
stages.note: Applying MsgPack_ReadFields (140febc30) to the chain: u16 msgid -> decoded+0x00; fieldType 4 base-128 varint (1..5 wire bytes, little-endian LSB group first) -> u32 at decoded+0x02; fieldType 2 u8 -> decoded+0x06; fieldType 2 u8 -> decoded+0x07; fieldType 4 varint -> u32 at decoded+0x08. defSize 0x0C, maxSize 0x0E (tools/re/MaxSizeWalk.py, protocol/schema/205780/maxsize.csv). This independently corroborates the packed record in research/contracts/notes/UI/Widgets/remote-equipped-skills.md and refines the two u32 members as varint-encoded on the wire.

fields.note: MP_MSGID (fieldType 1): 2 bytes at decoded+0x00. The id value 0x264 is carried in the descriptor's param slot (+0x10).

fieldType 4: base-128 varint, 1..5 wire bytes, little-endian (least-significant group first); decodes into a u32 slot. The handler resolves it through the skill-definition lookup. Wire length is not fixed at 4. Confirmed from a live capture (msg-dispatch-addenda Addendum 22): 0x11DC encodes as DC 23, 0x1206 as 86 24, 0x122B as AB 24.
fieldType 2: 1 wire byte. Passed to ChCliSkill::SetConfiguredSkill as the standard configured-skill slot (validated slot <= 4).
fieldType 2: 1 wire byte. Passed as the context selector; the exact enum meaning remains unresolved in remote-equipped-skills.md.

fieldType 4: base-128 varint, 1..5 wire bytes; decodes into a u32 slot. Passed to LookupPlayerById. Wire length is not fixed at 4. Confirmed from a live capture (msg-dispatch-addenda Addendum 22): player index 1 encodes as a single byte 01.

priorNativeSlotSketch.note: Preserved from the earlier handler-slot sketch. The schema-decoded record is only 0x0C bytes, so this native slot is not part of it; retained because its role was never established.

wireFixtures.provenance: Live game connection, build 205.780, captured at the 0x264 handler in x64dbg (msg-dispatch-addenda Addendum 22); fixture at tools/re/fixtures/205780/0x264-wire.json. The pre-packet cipher state was recovered by rewinding conn+0x12C by the frame length, and the derived ciphertext was independently located in the process's network buffer.
wireFixtures.sanitization: Only the 19-byte wire frame and its pre-packet cipher state are retained; the session key and player identity are not.
wireFixtures.expectedDecode: RC4 -> transport frame 0f000e00e0640286240200016402ab24010001 -> LZ4 -> two 0x264: skill 0x1206 slot 2 ctx 0 player 1; skill 0x122B slot 1 ctx 0 player 1.

unresolved.question: Does the live per-connection registry resolve 0x264 to the same defArray, and would another build or connection do the same?
unresolved.note: Resolved for this build and connection: the live game-connection recv registry was read in process (msg-dispatch-addenda Addendum 18) and emitted as protocol/schema/205780/live_ids.csv (Addendum 19), where 0x264 resolves to 1425cd320, matching this artifact. The static corpus is therefore reconciled with the live install for 0x264, and maxsize.csv is now live-derived (Addendum 21). What remains is cross-build/other-connection: the chain is build-local and the registry merge is per connection, so a different build or connection must be re-derived, not assumed equal.
